Коли обидві ноги розраховуються в DAI (наприклад KGST/aiBDT або DAI/aiETB), угода розраховується атомарно за один крок — без фази payment-sent/підтвердження; кошти йдуть напряму на dai-адресу тейкера. Ноги поза ланцюгом (USDT, USDC, банківський переказ) лишають ручний потік ескроу.
uk.doc.jobs.estimate: Оцініть комісію завдання до підпису — це eth_estimateGas для DAI. Надішліть ті самі поля, що й для надсилання; вузол оцінює весь конвеєр (текст вкладень, вихід навички й MCP, рядки набору даних, виклики планувальника й синтезу) і повертає токени ШІ, які будуть використані, мінімальну комісію, яку він приймає, і рекомендований бюджет. Лише читання — нічого не запускається й нічого не сплачується. Суми — сирі одиниці валюти комісії (μDAI для DAI; 1 DAI = 1e9 μDAI).
uk.doc.jobs.estimate.basis: Кожен учасник позначений як measured (пораховано точно — запит, текст вкладення, рядки набору), bounded (те, що отримала навичка або повернув інструмент MCP, обмежене виконуваним кодом, тож це діапазон {min,max}) або assumed. fees.minimum — поріг, нижче якого вузол відхиляє; fees.recommended покриває найгірший випадок. Валюта, яку ніхто не котирує в книзі P2P, повідомляється як unavailable, а не з ціною. Помилки: 422 dataset_not_installed, 404 skill_not_found, 400 для хибного вводу. Доступно на вузлах новіших за 0.4.36.

am.doc.toc.title: Contents
am.doc.overview.title: Wallet API Reference
am.doc.overview.about: DAI is a decentralized, peer-to-peer AI network — independent miners share GPU compute, models, skills and datasets directly with each other, with no company as gatekeeper. Post a job — a chat completion, a skill call, a compute task, an MCP tool run — and any miner that can handle it bids, runs it, and gets paid per token or per job once the work settles on-chain. This page documents the single HTTP API every miner exposes to do all of that: wallets and balances, job submission, chat and model routing, MCP tool servers, skills, history search, and more.
am.doc.overview.intro: Every DAI miner exposes an HTTP API on walletApiPort (default 3456). Balance responses are in μDAI (raw) — 1 DAI = 1 000 000 000 μDAI. Input amounts for /api/wallet/send and staking endpoints are in DAI (the server converts internally).
am.doc.overview.public: Public miners (e.g. miner.iamai.kg) expose the same routes over HTTPS. CORS is open for browser clients.
am.doc.gen.title: Generate Wallet
am.doc.gen.intro: A DAI wallet is an ed25519 keypair. The address is derived from the signing public key — no seed phrases, no custodians. Follow these four steps to create a wallet and start submitting jobs.
am.doc.gen.s1.title: Generate the keypair
am.doc.gen.s1.desc: Run this Node.js script (requires tweetnacl — npm i tweetnacl). It deterministically derives an ed25519 signing keypair from 32 random bytes, then computes the canonical DAI address as 'dai' + sha256(signingPublicKey).slice(0,40).
am.doc.gen.s1.note: Keep dai-wallet.json secret. The signingSecretKeyB64 is the private signing key — never share or commit it.
am.doc.gen.s2.title: Register the signing key on-chain
am.doc.gen.s2.desc: Post your address, signingPublicKey, and the proof from Step 1 to any miner. The proof is an ed25519 signature over your address — it proves you hold the private key. This binds your key to your address so the network can verify your job payment signatures.
am.doc.gen.s2.errors: Missing the proof returns 400 { "error": "address, signingPublicKey, and proof required" }. An invalid proof returns 403 { "error": "invalid proof" }. To rotate to a new key later, include a rotationProof signed by your existing key.
am.doc.gen.s2.free: Registration is free and only needs to happen once per keypair. It does not require any DAI balance.
am.doc.gen.s3.title: Fund the address
am.doc.gen.s3.desc: Compute and skill jobs require a signed paymentTx with sufficient budget. Fund your address via the P2P exchange, a transfer from another wallet, or a faucet. Check your balance at any time:
am.doc.gen.s4.title: Submit your first compute job
am.doc.gen.s4.desc: Sign a payment proof and post to /job. The snippet below uses the wallet file from Step 1.
am.doc.gen.quickref.title: Quick reference
am.doc.gen.quickref.1: Generate keypair & address locally — no network needed
am.doc.chain.title: Chain & Wallet
am.doc.chain.status: Node status — chain height, sync state, reputation.
am.doc.chain.info: Version, uptime, peer count, wallet address.
am.doc.chain.balance: Balance in μDAI for a DAI wallet address.
am.doc.chain.nonce: Current nonce for transaction / payment signing.
am.doc.chain.txbyid: One transaction by hash. Falls back to the mempool before returning 404. Mining rewards carry a synthetic id.
am.doc.chain.jobs: Public job history — joins job-submitted transitions with mined scanResults. Returns { jobs, latestSkillMemory, chatTurns }.
am.doc.chain.register: Register an ed25519 signing key for an address. Required before signed job payments. See Generate Wallet for how to produce the proof. proof = ed25519 signature over the address string.
am.doc.chain.send: Transfer DAI between wallets. The sender wallet must be stored on this node (loaded via walletManager). Amount is in DAI (not μDAI). Optional fee and memo fields.
am.doc.chain.txsubmit: Submit a pre-signed DAITransaction to the mempool.
am.doc.chain.supply: Chain supply audit — total issued vs. accounted balances.
am.doc.jobs.title: Jobs
am.doc.jobs.intro: Submit compute work to the network. Types: verdict (identity scan, free), skill, compute. skill and compute jobs require a signed payment proof (maxBudget in μDAI).
am.doc.jobs.pricing.title: Pricing & fees
am.doc.jobs.pricing.p1: Paid jobs are metered per AI compute token at 1 μDAI per token (the default gasPrice; μDAI is the smallest unit, so this is the floor). Since 1 DAI = 1 000 000 000 μDAI, one DAI buys up to 1 billion tokens.
am.doc.jobs.pricing.p2: The fee is tokensUsed × gasPrice and is never less than the tokens actually used (1 000 tokens ⇒ ≥ 1 000 μDAI). Unused budget is refunded. A maxBudget too small to cover the job's token cost is rejected with 402 FEE_TOO_LOW.
am.doc.jobs.pricing.p3: Block reward. On top of the fee, each block's ~1 DAI subsidy is split among the workers who completed jobs, weighted by delivered compute (a deterministic token estimate — splitting into many nodes earns nothing extra), minus a small (~10%) proposer cut. Blocks with no real work mint only a small keepalive, so emission tracks demand.
am.doc.jobs.pricing.p4: DAI has no fixed price — the market defines it via the best open P2P order (see GET /api/p2p/price).
am.doc.jobs.submit: Submit a job. Returns { jobId, statusUrl, resultUrl }. id is generated by the client and signed into the payment proof: paymentTx.txHash is a SHA-256 of JSON.stringify({ jobId, requesterAddress, minerAddress, amount, nonce }) — not a blockchain transaction hash. minerAddress comes from GET /api/miner/info; nonce is the wallet's current /api/wallet/nonce value; the signature is over the hex hash string. When paying in a stablecoin, append currency to the hashed object.
am.doc.jobs.sealed.title: የታሸጉ ምላሾች
am.doc.jobs.sealed: ይፋዊ ሥራ payload.requesterEncryptionPublicKey ማዘጋጀት ይችላል (የጠያቂው X25519 ቁልፍ)። ሰንሰለቱ ከዚያ ፕሮምፕቱን እንደ promptCipher፣ ምላሹንም እንደ profile.replyCipher ያከማቻል፣ computeOutput ደግሞ null ይሆናል። ሥራው አሁንም ይዘረዘራል — ምስጠራው አያስወግደውም። ያ ቁልፍ ብቻ ጽሑፉን ይከፍታል። GET /job/:id/statusን ይጠይቁ (መጀመሪያ ይህ ማዕድን አውጪ፣ ከዚያ የሥራ ሰሌዳው፣ ከዚያ ሰንሰለቱ) ወይም GET /api/wallet/jobs?address=። GET /jobboard/status?jobId= የቀጥታ ወረፋ ነው፦ ያለቀ ሥራን ብሎክ እስኪያካትተው ድረስ ይይዛል፣ ከዚያም ለ10 ደቂቃ።
am.doc.jobs.board: ከPOST /job ጋር አንድ አይነት አካል፣ ማንኛውም ማዕድን አውጪ ሥራውን እንዲጎትት ወደ ቡትኖድ ይላካል። የክፍያ ሃሽ sha256 ነው፣ ከJSON.stringify({ jobId, requesterAddress, amount, nonce }) — minerAddress የለም፣ ሠራተኛው ገና ስላልታወቀ። በወረፋ ላይ እያለ GET /jobboard/status?jobId=ን ይጠይቁ። ከተካተተ በኋላ ያው ሥራ በGET /job/:id/status እና በቦርሳው የሥራ ዝርዝር ውስጥ ይገኛል።
am.doc.jobs.status: Poll job state: queued, computing, done, error. A miss in this process's memory is looked up on the job board and then on chain, so a board job stays visible after the queue drops it.
am.doc.jobs.result: Full result when the job is done. Cleartext replies are in profile.computeOutput. Sealed replies are in profile.replyCipher (computeOutput is null) — open that envelope with the requester's X25519 key.
am.doc.jobs.list: List active jobs on this node.
am.doc.jobs.gossip: Receive P2P gossip envelopes from peer miners.
am.doc.chat.title: Chat & Routing
am.doc.chat.route: Route a message to the best matching skill.
am.doc.chat.ask: Full AI reply — routes to a skill or free chat. Accepts optional attachments (text files or images, ≤1 MB total). Images force a vision-capable model. May return { fromChainHistory: true } for cached on-chain replies.
am.doc.chat.attachments: Attachments are an optional array of { type: 'text'|'image', data: '<base64>', filename?: '...' }. Text is inlined into the prompt; images select a vision model automatically. Max 1 MB per request.
am.doc.chat.context:
Private vs public context
Private chat uses in-memory session history. Public (paid) jobs also pull on-chain history via /api/wallet/jobs so follow-ups work across devices.
am.doc.mcp.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
am.doc.mcp.intro: Connect external MCP servers to add tools to chat and compute jobs. Configure servers via Electron Settings or config.json.
am.doc.mcp.status: List connected MCP servers and their available tools. Returns { servers: [{ name, status, toolCount, tools: [{ name, description }] }] }.
am.doc.mcp.chat:
MCP in chat
When you ask a question in /chat/ask or /chat/route, the miner can invoke MCP tools (up to 3 rounds). Tool results are fed back into the LLM for a final reply. Tool names are namespaced: <server>__<tool>.
am.doc.mcp.config: Add servers to config.json under mcpServers (standard Claude Desktop / Cursor format):
am.doc.mcp.electron: Electron users: paste server config into Settings → MCP Servers instead of editing config.json manually.
am.doc.search.title: Chat History Search
am.doc.search.intro: Meilisearch runs locally on each miner (port 7700). Remote clients call these wallet API routes — not Meilisearch directly.
am.doc.search.suggest: Autocomplete from indexed blockchain job history — past prompts and reply snippets.
am.doc.search.match: Return a full cached reply when the prompt closely matches prior on-chain history (similarity ≥ 0.86).
am.doc.explorer.title: Blockchain Explorer
am.doc.explorer.blocks: Recent blocks (newest first). Each entry includes jobCount when the block contains mined results.
am.doc.explorer.block: Full block JSON — scanResults, stateTransitions, hash, miner, reward.
am.doc.explorer.search: Lookup by block height, tx/block hash, or wallet address. Address search returns balance, transfers, and completed jobs.
am.doc.skills.title: Skills
am.doc.skills.intro: On-demand agent modules. Deploy a public skill for 1 DAI; community staking reaches 10 DAI to graduate a skill network-wide.
am.doc.skills.list: List skills with staking totals and economics: { proposeFeeDai, graduationThresholdDai }.
am.doc.skills.prefs: Skill enable/disable and staking preferences for a wallet.
am.doc.skills.propose: Propose a new skill. Public proposals cost 1 DAI (escrowed for code_audit).
am.doc.skills.stake: Stake DAI toward skill graduation. Amount is in DAI (not μDAI). Uses the node's own wallet.
am.doc.skills.unstake: Withdraw staked DAI from a proposed skill.
am.doc.skills.toggle: Toggle whether this node runs a skill.
am.doc.hf.title: HF Datasets
am.doc.hf.intro: Hugging Face datasets installed on this node. Compute jobs can reference them by ID. Chat will suggest installs when a dataset is missing. Datasets are stored under ~/.dai-miner/brain-data/hf-datasets/.
am.doc.hf.list: List installed datasets. Returns { datasets: [{ id, files, rowCount, source }] }.
am.doc.hf.download: Install a dataset by Hugging Face ID. Falls back to pulling from a peer miner if HF is unreachable. Returns { ok: true, manifest } on success.
am.doc.hf.delete: Remove an installed dataset from this node.
am.doc.llm.title: LLM & Brain
am.doc.llm.intro: Inference runs in-process via QVAC. Brain state stores human feedback and signal weights.
am.doc.llm.chat: Streaming chat via local QVAC (Ollama-compatible body).
am.doc.llm.models: Models available on this node (built-in + loaded + registry).
am.doc.llm.networkmodels: Aggregated model list from connected peers.
am.doc.llm.brainstate: Weights count, feedback count, model info.
am.doc.llm.feedback: Submit a human correction to improve signal weights.
am.doc.p2p.title: P2P Exchange
am.doc.p2p.intro: Peer-to-peer DAI trading with on-chain escrow.
am.doc.p2p.currencies: Supported quotes and on-chain bases. Includes KGST and USDT wires.
am.doc.p2p.markets: Pair list with last price (mid from the open book) and 24h change. change24h is null until history exists. Optional ?pair=BASE-QUOTE (e.g. KGST-USDT-TRC20).
am.doc.p2p.price: Reference DAI price — the market price derived only from the best open P2P order(s): { price (mid), bestBid, bestAsk, source }. Omit quoteCurrency for a per-currency map. DAI has no oracle/fixed price.
am.doc.p2p.createorder: Create a buy or sell order.
am.doc.p2p.select: Taker selects an order to begin a trade. Optional takerPayoutAddress is the taker's off-chain receive address when taking a buy.
am.doc.p2p.mytrades: Active and completed trades for an address.
am.doc.push.title: Push Notifications
am.doc.push.register: Register an Expo push token for a wallet address.
am.doc.push.send: Send a push notification. Optional address filter.
am.doc.errors.title: Errors & Auth
am.doc.errors.json: Responses are JSON. Errors return { "error": "message" } with an appropriate HTTP status (400, 401, 402, 404, 500).
am.doc.errors.payment: Payment-required (402): skill/compute jobs without a valid signed paymentTx are rejected before execution.
am.doc.errors.signing: Signing: register your ed25519 key via /api/wallet/register-key, then sign payment proofs binding jobId + minerWallet + maxBudget + nonce.
am.doc.errors.sdks: SDKs: use runCompute() / submitJob() in dai-miner SDK to handle signing automatically, and estimate() to price a job first.
am.doc.foot.tag: DAI Miner Network API — port 3456 by default
am.doc.assets.title: Stablecoins & multi-currency
am.doc.assets.p1: Fourteen regional stablecoins ride on the DAI chain alongside DAI: KGST (Kyrgyzstan som, bridged across DAI/BSC/Tron) plus αιETB, αιBTN, αιVES, αιPYG, αιBDT, αιPKR, αιEGP, αιIQD, αιAOA, αιCUP, αιLYD, αιSDG, αιIRR (wire tickers aiETB, aiBTN, aiVES, aiPYG, aiBDT, aiPKR, aiEGP, aiIQD, aiAOA, aiCUP, aiLYD, aiSDG, aiIRR). All use 2 decimals (1 unit = 100 raw); DAI keeps 9 (1 DAI = 1e9 μDAI). Off-chain on-ramps: USDT (USDT-ERC20, USDT-TRC20, USDT-TON, USDT-SOL, USDT-BEP20), USDC, and bank transfer.
am.doc.assets.p2: GET /api/assets lists every on-chain asset with decimals, display names and per-currency gas prices. GET /api/wallet/balance returns an additional assets map with each stablecoin's raw and display balance.
am.doc.assets.p3: Transfers: POST /api/wallet/send (and /api/tx/submit) accept a currency field — omit it for DAI. A transaction's signed hash includes currency ONLY when non-DAI, so existing DAI transactions and signatures remain valid unchanged.
am.doc.jobs.pricing.currency: Job fees can be paid in DAI or any on-chain stablecoin: set currency on the job payload. The fee floor is priced per currency, and the miner receives exactly the currency paid — no conversion.
am.doc.p2p.swap: On-chain DAI assets (DAI, aiETB, aiBTN, aiBDT, aiPKR, …) + bridged KGST (DAI/BSC/Tron) trade as base. When both legs settle on DAI (e.g. KGST/aiBDT or DAI/aiETB) the trade settles atomically in one step — no payment-sent/confirm phase; proceeds go directly to the taker's dai address. Off-chain legs (USDT, USDC, bank transfer) keep the manual escrow flow.
am.doc.jobs.estimate: የሥራ ክፍያን ከመፈረምዎ በፊት ይገምቱ — ይህ የDAI eth_estimateGas ነው። የሚያስገቡትን ተመሳሳይ መስኮች ይላኩ፤ ኖዱ መላውን የሥራ መስመር ይለካል (የአባሪ ጽሑፍ፣ የክህሎት እና የMCP ውጤት፣ የውሂብ ስብስብ ረድፎች፣ የዕቅድ አውጪ እና የማዋሃድ ጥሪዎች) እና የሚጠቀምባቸውን የAI ቶከኖች፣ የሚቀበለውን ዝቅተኛ ክፍያ እና የሚመከር በጀት ይመልሳል። ለንባብ ብቻ — ምንም አይሠራም፣ ምንምም አይከፈልም። መጠኖች የክፍያ ገንዘቡ ጥሬ አሃዶች ናቸው (ለDAI μDAI፤ 1 DAI = 1e9 μDAI)።
am.doc.jobs.estimate.basis: እያንዳንዱ አስተዋጽኦ measured (በትክክል የተቆጠረ — ፕሮምፕት፣ የአባሪ ጽሑፍ፣ የውሂብ ስብስብ ረድፎች)፣ bounded (ክህሎት ያመጣው ወይም የMCP መሣሪያ የመለሰው በሚሠራው ኮድ ይገደባል፣ ስለዚህ የ{min,max} ክልል ነው) ወይም assumed ተብሎ ይሰየማል። fees.minimum ኖዱ ከዚያ በታች የሚያልፈው አይደለም፤ fees.recommended መጥፎውን ሁኔታ ይሸፍናል። ማንም በP2P የትዕዛዝ መዝገብ ላይ ዋጋ የማይሰጥበት ገንዘብ ዋጋ ከመሰጠት ይልቅ unavailable ተብሎ ይገለጻል። ስህተቶች፦ 422 dataset_not_installed፣ 404 skill_not_found፣ ለመጥፎ ግብዓት 400። ከ0.4.36 አዲስ በሆኑ ኖዶች ላይ ይገኛል።

dz.doc.toc.title: Contents
dz.doc.overview.title: Wallet API Reference
dz.doc.overview.about: DAI is a decentralized, peer-to-peer AI network — independent miners share GPU compute, models, skills and datasets directly with each other, with no company as gatekeeper. Post a job — a chat completion, a skill call, a compute task, an MCP tool run — and any miner that can handle it bids, runs it, and gets paid per token or per job once the work settles on-chain. This page documents the single HTTP API every miner exposes to do all of that: wallets and balances, job submission, chat and model routing, MCP tool servers, skills, history search, and more.
dz.doc.overview.intro: Every DAI miner exposes an HTTP API on walletApiPort (default 3456). Balance responses are in μDAI (raw) — 1 DAI = 1 000 000 000 μDAI. Input amounts for /api/wallet/send and staking endpoints are in DAI (the server converts internally).
dz.doc.overview.public: Public miners (e.g. miner.iamai.kg) expose the same routes over HTTPS. CORS is open for browser clients.
dz.doc.gen.title: Generate Wallet
dz.doc.gen.intro: A DAI wallet is an ed25519 keypair. The address is derived from the signing public key — no seed phrases, no custodians. Follow these four steps to create a wallet and start submitting jobs.
dz.doc.gen.s1.title: Generate the keypair
dz.doc.gen.s1.desc: Run this Node.js script (requires tweetnacl — npm i tweetnacl). It deterministically derives an ed25519 signing keypair from 32 random bytes, then computes the canonical DAI address as 'dai' + sha256(signingPublicKey).slice(0,40).
dz.doc.gen.s1.note: Keep dai-wallet.json secret. The signingSecretKeyB64 is the private signing key — never share or commit it.
dz.doc.gen.s2.title: Register the signing key on-chain
dz.doc.gen.s2.desc: Post your address, signingPublicKey, and the proof from Step 1 to any miner. The proof is an ed25519 signature over your address — it proves you hold the private key. This binds your key to your address so the network can verify your job payment signatures.
dz.doc.gen.s2.errors: Missing the proof returns 400 { "error": "address, signingPublicKey, and proof required" }. An invalid proof returns 403 { "error": "invalid proof" }. To rotate to a new key later, include a rotationProof signed by your existing key.
dz.doc.gen.s2.free: Registration is free and only needs to happen once per keypair. It does not require any DAI balance.
dz.doc.gen.s3.title: Fund the address
dz.doc.gen.s3.desc: Compute and skill jobs require a signed paymentTx with sufficient budget. Fund your address via the P2P exchange, a transfer from another wallet, or a faucet. Check your balance at any time:
dz.doc.gen.s4.title: Submit your first compute job
dz.doc.gen.s4.desc: Sign a payment proof and post to /job. The snippet below uses the wallet file from Step 1.
dz.doc.gen.quickref.title: Quick reference
dz.doc.gen.quickref.1: Generate keypair & address locally — no network needed
dz.doc.chain.title: Chain & Wallet
dz.doc.chain.status: Node status — chain height, sync state, reputation.
dz.doc.chain.info: Version, uptime, peer count, wallet address.
dz.doc.chain.balance: Balance in μDAI for a DAI wallet address.
dz.doc.chain.nonce: Current nonce for transaction / payment signing.
dz.doc.chain.txbyid: One transaction by hash. Falls back to the mempool before returning 404. Mining rewards carry a synthetic id.
dz.doc.chain.jobs: Public job history — joins job-submitted transitions with mined scanResults. Returns { jobs, latestSkillMemory, chatTurns }.
dz.doc.chain.register: Register an ed25519 signing key for an address. Required before signed job payments. See Generate Wallet for how to produce the proof. proof = ed25519 signature over the address string.
dz.doc.chain.send: Transfer DAI between wallets. The sender wallet must be stored on this node (loaded via walletManager). Amount is in DAI (not μDAI). Optional fee and memo fields.
dz.doc.chain.txsubmit: Submit a pre-signed DAITransaction to the mempool.
dz.doc.chain.supply: Chain supply audit — total issued vs. accounted balances.
dz.doc.jobs.title: Jobs
dz.doc.jobs.intro: Submit compute work to the network. Types: verdict (identity scan, free), skill, compute. skill and compute jobs require a signed payment proof (maxBudget in μDAI).
dz.doc.jobs.pricing.title: Pricing & fees
dz.doc.jobs.pricing.p1: Paid jobs are metered per AI compute token at 1 μDAI per token (the default gasPrice; μDAI is the smallest unit, so this is the floor). Since 1 DAI = 1 000 000 000 μDAI, one DAI buys up to 1 billion tokens.
dz.doc.jobs.pricing.p2: The fee is tokensUsed × gasPrice and is never less than the tokens actually used (1 000 tokens ⇒ ≥ 1 000 μDAI). Unused budget is refunded. A maxBudget too small to cover the job's token cost is rejected with 402 FEE_TOO_LOW.
dz.doc.jobs.pricing.p3: Block reward. On top of the fee, each block's ~1 DAI subsidy is split among the workers who completed jobs, weighted by delivered compute (a deterministic token estimate — splitting into many nodes earns nothing extra), minus a small (~10%) proposer cut. Blocks with no real work mint only a small keepalive, so emission tracks demand.
dz.doc.jobs.pricing.p4: DAI has no fixed price — the market defines it via the best open P2P order (see GET /api/p2p/price).
dz.doc.jobs.submit: Submit a job. Returns { jobId, statusUrl, resultUrl }. id is generated by the client and signed into the payment proof: paymentTx.txHash is a SHA-256 of JSON.stringify({ jobId, requesterAddress, minerAddress, amount, nonce }) — not a blockchain transaction hash. minerAddress comes from GET /api/miner/info; nonce is the wallet's current /api/wallet/nonce value; the signature is over the hex hash string. When paying in a stablecoin, append currency to the hashed object.
dz.doc.jobs.sealed.title: བསྡམ་བཞག་པའི་ལན།
dz.doc.jobs.sealed: མི་མང་གི་ལཱ་ཅིག་གིས་ payload.requesterEncryptionPublicKey བཀོད་ཚུགས (ཞུ་མིའི་ X25519 ལྡེ་མིག)། དེ་ལས་ ལྕགས་ཐག་གིས་ བརྡ་སྟོན་འདི་ promptCipher སྦེ་དང་ ལན་འདི་ profile.replyCipher སྦེ་བཞག་དོ། computeOutput འདི་ null ཨིན། ལཱ་འདི་ ད་རུང་ཐོ་ནང་སྡོད་དོ — གསང་བཟོ་འབད་མི་གིས་ དེ་མ་བཏོན། ལྡེ་མིག་དེ་གིས་རྐྱངམ་ཅིག་ ཡི་གུ་ཁ་ཕྱེ་ཚུགས། GET /job/:id/status ལུ་འདྲི (འགོ་ཐོག་ གཏེར་སྐྲུན་པ་འདི། དེ་ལས་ ལཱ་སྒྲོམ། དེ་ལས་ ལྕགས་ཐག) ཡང་ན་ GET /api/wallet/jobs?address=། GET /jobboard/status?jobId= འདི་ ཐད་ཀར་གྱི་གྲལ་ཨིན། མཇུག་བསྡུ་ཚར་མི་ལཱ་འདི་ སྡེ་ཚན་ཅིག་གིས་ནང་ན་མ་བཙུགས་ཚུན་བཞག་སྟེ་ དེ་ལས་ སྐར་མ་ 10 གི་རིང་ལུ་བཞག་དོ།
dz.doc.jobs.board: POST /job གི་ལུས་དང་འདྲཝ་སྦེ་ བུཊི་ནོཌ་ལུ་བཏང་ཡི། གཏེར་སྐྲུན་པ་ག་གིས་ཡང་ ལཱ་འདི་འཐེན་ཚུགསཔ་ལུ། སྤྲོད་དངུལ་གྱི་ཧེཤ་འདི་ sha256 ཨིན། དེ་ JSON.stringify({ jobId, requesterAddress, amount, nonce }) གི་ཨིན — minerAddress མེད། ལཱ་འབད་མི་འདི་ ད་ལྟོ་ཤེས་མ་ཚུགས་པ་ལས། གྲལ་ནང་ཡོད་པའི་སྐབས་ GET /jobboard/status?jobId= ལུ་འདྲི། ནང་ན་བཙུགས་ཚར་བའི་ཤུལ་ལས་ ལཱ་དེ་ག་རང་ GET /job/:id/status ནང་དང་ སྒྱེ་ཁུག་གི་ལཱ་ཐོ་ནང་ཡོད།
dz.doc.jobs.status: Poll job state: queued, computing, done, error. A miss in this process's memory is looked up on the job board and then on chain, so a board job stays visible after the queue drops it.
dz.doc.jobs.result: Full result when the job is done. Cleartext replies are in profile.computeOutput. Sealed replies are in profile.replyCipher (computeOutput is null) — open that envelope with the requester's X25519 key.
dz.doc.jobs.list: List active jobs on this node.
dz.doc.jobs.gossip: Receive P2P gossip envelopes from peer miners.
dz.doc.chat.title: Chat & Routing
dz.doc.chat.route: Route a message to the best matching skill.
dz.doc.chat.ask: Full AI reply — routes to a skill or free chat. Accepts optional attachments (text files or images, ≤1 MB total). Images force a vision-capable model. May return { fromChainHistory: true } for cached on-chain replies.
dz.doc.chat.attachments: Attachments are an optional array of { type: 'text'|'image', data: '<base64>', filename?: '...' }. Text is inlined into the prompt; images select a vision model automatically. Max 1 MB per request.
dz.doc.chat.context:
Private vs public context
Private chat uses in-memory session history. Public (paid) jobs also pull on-chain history via /api/wallet/jobs so follow-ups work across devices.
dz.doc.mcp.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
dz.doc.mcp.intro: Connect external MCP servers to add tools to chat and compute jobs. Configure servers via Electron Settings or config.json.
dz.doc.mcp.status: List connected MCP servers and their available tools. Returns { servers: [{ name, status, toolCount, tools: [{ name, description }] }] }.
dz.doc.mcp.chat:
MCP in chat
When you ask a question in /chat/ask or /chat/route, the miner can invoke MCP tools (up to 3 rounds). Tool results are fed back into the LLM for a final reply. Tool names are namespaced: <server>__<tool>.
dz.doc.mcp.config: Add servers to config.json under mcpServers (standard Claude Desktop / Cursor format):
dz.doc.mcp.electron: Electron users: paste server config into Settings → MCP Servers instead of editing config.json manually.
dz.doc.search.title: Chat History Search
dz.doc.search.intro: Meilisearch runs locally on each miner (port 7700). Remote clients call these wallet API routes — not Meilisearch directly.
dz.doc.search.suggest: Autocomplete from indexed blockchain job history — past prompts and reply snippets.
dz.doc.search.match: Return a full cached reply when the prompt closely matches prior on-chain history (similarity ≥ 0.86).
dz.doc.explorer.title: Blockchain Explorer
dz.doc.explorer.blocks: Recent blocks (newest first). Each entry includes jobCount when the block contains mined results.
dz.doc.explorer.block: Full block JSON — scanResults, stateTransitions, hash, miner, reward.
dz.doc.explorer.search: Lookup by block height, tx/block hash, or wallet address. Address search returns balance, transfers, and completed jobs.
dz.doc.skills.title: Skills
dz.doc.skills.intro: On-demand agent modules. Deploy a public skill for 1 DAI; community staking reaches 10 DAI to graduate a skill network-wide.
dz.doc.skills.list: List skills with staking totals and economics: { proposeFeeDai, graduationThresholdDai }.
dz.doc.skills.prefs: Skill enable/disable and staking preferences for a wallet.
dz.doc.skills.propose: Propose a new skill. Public proposals cost 1 DAI (escrowed for code_audit).
dz.doc.skills.stake: Stake DAI toward skill graduation. Amount is in DAI (not μDAI). Uses the node's own wallet.
dz.doc.skills.unstake: Withdraw staked DAI from a proposed skill.
dz.doc.skills.toggle: Toggle whether this node runs a skill.
dz.doc.hf.title: HF Datasets
dz.doc.hf.intro: Hugging Face datasets installed on this node. Compute jobs can reference them by ID. Chat will suggest installs when a dataset is missing. Datasets are stored under ~/.dai-miner/brain-data/hf-datasets/.
dz.doc.hf.list: List installed datasets. Returns { datasets: [{ id, files, rowCount, source }] }.
dz.doc.hf.download: Install a dataset by Hugging Face ID. Falls back to pulling from a peer miner if HF is unreachable. Returns { ok: true, manifest } on success.
dz.doc.hf.delete: Remove an installed dataset from this node.
dz.doc.llm.title: LLM & Brain
dz.doc.llm.intro: Inference runs in-process via QVAC. Brain state stores human feedback and signal weights.
dz.doc.llm.chat: Streaming chat via local QVAC (Ollama-compatible body).
dz.doc.llm.models: Models available on this node (built-in + loaded + registry).
dz.doc.llm.networkmodels: Aggregated model list from connected peers.
dz.doc.llm.brainstate: Weights count, feedback count, model info.
dz.doc.llm.feedback: Submit a human correction to improve signal weights.
dz.doc.p2p.title: P2P Exchange
dz.doc.p2p.intro: Peer-to-peer DAI trading with on-chain escrow.
dz.doc.p2p.currencies: Supported quotes and on-chain bases. Includes KGST and USDT wires.
dz.doc.p2p.markets: Pair list with last price (mid from the open book) and 24h change. change24h is null until history exists. Optional ?pair=BASE-QUOTE (e.g. KGST-USDT-TRC20).
dz.doc.p2p.price: Reference DAI price — the market price derived only from the best open P2P order(s): { price (mid), bestBid, bestAsk, source }. Omit quoteCurrency for a per-currency map. DAI has no oracle/fixed price.
dz.doc.p2p.createorder: Create a buy or sell order.
dz.doc.p2p.select: Taker selects an order to begin a trade. Optional takerPayoutAddress is the taker's off-chain receive address when taking a buy.
dz.doc.p2p.mytrades: Active and completed trades for an address.
dz.doc.push.title: Push Notifications
dz.doc.push.register: Register an Expo push token for a wallet address.
dz.doc.push.send: Send a push notification. Optional address filter.
dz.doc.errors.title: Errors & Auth
dz.doc.errors.json: Responses are JSON. Errors return { "error": "message" } with an appropriate HTTP status (400, 401, 402, 404, 500).
dz.doc.errors.payment: Payment-required (402): skill/compute jobs without a valid signed paymentTx are rejected before execution.
dz.doc.errors.signing: Signing: register your ed25519 key via /api/wallet/register-key, then sign payment proofs binding jobId + minerWallet + maxBudget + nonce.
dz.doc.errors.sdks: SDKs: use runCompute() / submitJob() in dai-miner SDK to handle signing automatically, and estimate() to price a job first.
dz.doc.foot.tag: DAI Miner Network API — port 3456 by default
dz.doc.assets.title: Stablecoins & multi-currency
dz.doc.assets.p1: Fourteen regional stablecoins ride on the DAI chain alongside DAI: KGST (Kyrgyzstan som, bridged across DAI/BSC/Tron) plus αιETB, αιBTN, αιVES, αιPYG, αιBDT, αιPKR, αιEGP, αιIQD, αιAOA, αιCUP, αιLYD, αιSDG, αιIRR (wire tickers aiETB, aiBTN, aiVES, aiPYG, aiBDT, aiPKR, aiEGP, aiIQD, aiAOA, aiCUP, aiLYD, aiSDG, aiIRR). All use 2 decimals (1 unit = 100 raw); DAI keeps 9 (1 DAI = 1e9 μDAI). Off-chain on-ramps: USDT (USDT-ERC20, USDT-TRC20, USDT-TON, USDT-SOL, USDT-BEP20), USDC, and bank transfer.
dz.doc.assets.p2: GET /api/assets lists every on-chain asset with decimals, display names and per-currency gas prices. GET /api/wallet/balance returns an additional assets map with each stablecoin's raw and display balance.
dz.doc.assets.p3: Transfers: POST /api/wallet/send (and /api/tx/submit) accept a currency field — omit it for DAI. A transaction's signed hash includes currency ONLY when non-DAI, so existing DAI transactions and signatures remain valid unchanged.
dz.doc.jobs.pricing.currency: Job fees can be paid in DAI or any on-chain stablecoin: set currency on the job payload. The fee floor is priced per currency, and the miner receives exactly the currency paid — no conversion.
dz.doc.p2p.swap: On-chain DAI assets (DAI, aiETB, aiBTN, aiBDT, aiPKR, …) + bridged KGST (DAI/BSC/Tron) trade as base. When both legs settle on DAI (e.g. KGST/aiBDT or DAI/aiETB) the trade settles atomically in one step — no payment-sent/confirm phase; proceeds go directly to the taker's dai address. Off-chain legs (USDT, USDC, bank transfer) keep the manual escrow flow.
dz.doc.jobs.estimate: ལཱ་གི་གླ་འདི་ མིང་རྟགས་མ་བཀོད་པའི་ ཧེ་མ ཚོད་རྩིས་རྐྱབ — འདི་ DAI གི་ eth_estimateGas ཨིན། ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་བཙུགས་པའི་སྐབས་གཏང་མི་ས་སྒོ་དེ་ག་རང་གཏང། ནོཌ་གིས་ ལས་རིམ་ཧྲིལ་བུ་ཚད་རྩིས་རྐྱབ་དོ (མཉམ་སྦྱར་གྱི་ཡི་གུ། ལག་རྩལ་དང་ MCP གི་ཕྱིར་ཐོན། གནས་སྡུད་ཀྱི་གྲལ། འཆར་གཞི་དང་ མཉམ་སྡེབ་ཀྱི་འབོད་བརྡ) དེ་ལས་ ལག་ལེན་འཐབ་ནི་ཡོད་མི་ AI ཊོ་ཀེན། དེ་གིས་ངོས་ལེན་འབད་མི་ཉུང་ཤོས་གླ། དེ་ལས་ འོས་སྦྱོར་གྱི་འགྲོ་སོང། ལོག་བཏང་དོ། ལྷག་ནི་རྐྱངམ་ཅིག — ག་ཅི་ཡང་མི་གཡོག། ག་ཅི་ཡང་མི་སྤྲོད། དངུལ་འབོར་ཚུ་ གླའི་དངུལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་ཆ་ཚན་ཨིན (DAI ལུ་ μDAI། 1 DAI = 1e9 μDAI)།
dz.doc.jobs.estimate.basis: ཕན་འདེབས་རེ་རེ་ལུ་ measured (ཏག་ཏག་བརྐྱབ་ཡོདཔ — བརྡ་སྟོན། མཉམ་སྦྱར་གྱི་ཡི་གུ། གནས་སྡུད་ཀྱི་གྲལ)། bounded (ལག་རྩལ་ཅིག་གིས་འཐེན་མི་ཡང་ན་ MCP ལག་ཆས་ཅིག་གིས་ལོག་བཏང་མི་འདི་ གཡོག་བཀོལ་མི་ཀོཌ་གིས་ཚད་བཀག་ཡོདཔ་ལས་ འདི་ {min,max} ཁྱབ་ཚད་ཅིག་ཨིན) ཡང་ན་ assumed གི་ངོ་རྟགས་བཀལ་དོ། fees.minimum འདི་ ནོཌ་གིས་དེ་གི་འོག་ལུ་ངོས་ལེན་མི་འབད་མི་ཚད་ཨིན། fees.recommended གིས་ སྡུག་ཤོས་གནས་སྟངས་ཁྱབ་དོ། P2P དེབ་ནང་ ག་གིས་ཡང་གོང་ཚད་མ་བཀོད་མི་དངུལ་འདི་ གོང་ཚད་མ་བཀོད་པར་ unavailable སྦེ་སྙན་ཞུ་འབད་དོ། ནོར་འཁྲུལ: 422 dataset_not_installed། 404 skill_not_found། ནང་འཇུག་མ་ལེགས་པ་ལུ་ 400། 0.4.36 ལས་གསརཔ་ཡོད་མི་ནོཌ་ཚུ་ནང་འཐོབ་དོ།
